caption: 2026 Nepal flood — Bhote Koshi debris surge at Rasuwagadhi (China–Nepal border)
notes: On 26 August 2026 an ice-rock avalanche collapsed into the Lhende Khola in Tibet, sending a debris flood down the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli rivers through Rasuwa and Nuwakot districts. The surge destroyed the Gyirong Port customs complex at Rasuwagadhi and wiped out the Timure border market. Left: Esri Wayback 2026-08-05 (pre-flood). Right: Esri current mosaic (post-flood).
